newsitem.title: philippines: Lower PLDT net, Dow's fall pull down Manila stocks.
newsitem.headline: Lower PLDT net, Dow's fall pull down Manila stocks.

text.p: Manila stocks slumped at the open on Monday due to disappointment over the first quarter income of market leader Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co, traders said.

Reports of a drop in the first quarter income of PLDT exacerbated fears the property market was headed for troubled times, brokers said. The main index was down 10.10 points at 2,862.27 after 20 minutes of trade.
"PLDT was our only hope this week. We were expecting better income," said Monique Lecaros, trader at Sun Hung Kai Securities.
PLDT said on Monday redundancy costs cut into its first quarter income taking it down to 1.28 billion pesos from 1.31 billion year-ago.
Other brokers said the 53-point drop of the Dow Jones on Friday also kept most foreign investors on the sidelines.
Debutant Boulevard Properties Holdings Inc added to the gloom after it opened at 90 centavos, down from its offer price of one peso. PLDT shed five pesos to 1,550.
Traders said they expect the index to remain in negative territory for the rest of the session.
